ontology-precedence: Frontmatter ontology takes precedence over conflicting body ontology; the overridden body evidence is retained for explanation.
bidirectional-inferred: Ordinary links provide evidence in both directions, so the pair resolves to an inferred friend relationship.
hidden: The relationship is indexed but hidden from this source note's visible neighbourhood.
date-property: An Obsidian Date property maps to a Daily Notes target using its configured field role or the default Date role.
source:body-url: The visible relationship is derived from body URL evidence.
defined-ontology: Defined ontology determines the visible relationship; inferred link evidence remains recorded but does not override it.
source:obsidian-link: The visible relationship is derived from resolved note link evidence.
conflicting-defined-roles: Multiple active defined ontology roles conflict, so the pair is presented laterally as a friend relationship.
source:url-origin: The visible relationship is derived from URL origin hierarchy evidence.
